tracks.theme: High summer in the green meadows - Sonamarg and Gulmarg's pastures lush and cool with the gondola running, and the Dal like glass at dawn while the plains bake
tracks.subject: The high meadows are cool, green and wide open

tracks.theme: Peak Yatra-week demand and loss-aversion - Pahalgam and Sonamarg going 3-4 weeks out and Srinagar busy; an unlisted stay loses the guest to a listed one
tracks.subject: Every listed room is filling this week, except yours

tracks.theme: Peak-season rides and loss-aversion - airport runs, valley drives and golden-hour shikaras booking all day during the Yatra; an idle cab or boat loses the fare to a listed one
tracks.subject: The golden-hour shikaras are booking without your boat
